paper_only_notice: Simulated at observed completed market closes, not broker fills. No live order API, no real funds or account connected.

weighting_policy.inputs: 40 forward-only investability research scores (estimated factors confidence-shrunk)
weighting_policy.weight_formula: 12% equally spread over 40; 88% in capped softmax of (research_score-mean)/max(std,7.5), name <=10% of stock budget and sector <=45% of stock budget
weighting_policy.remainder: Redistribute capped excess to eligible stocks in score-proportional weights
weighting_policy.execution_prices: Observed closes only; no estimated executions
weighting_policy.historical_validation: Not backtested with historical investability scores

forward_performance.source: paper ledger future completed closes only
